title: Stovetop Chocolate Pudding
description: Silky, dark, and ready for the good glasses.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the sugar, cocoa, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until it bubbles and thickens, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the chocolate, butter, and vanilla until glossy.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Divide among four glasses and chill at least 2 hours.
